title: How to Remind Your Boss of Your PTO Without Pissing Them Off

claims.claim: Izin taleplerinin 4 ila 6 ay onceden yapilabilecegi belirtilmistir.

evidence.quote: If you like to plan in advance, you might request time off four to six months out.

claims.claim: Izin talebi icin 4 ila 6 haftanin genellikle uygun bir sure oldugu ifade edilmistir.

evidence.quote: If this conversation doesn't give you much clarity, four to six weeks before your time off is probably about right.

claims.claim: Dugun veya iadesiz seyahat gibi durumlar icin 6 ay veya daha onceden basvurulabilecegi belirtilmistir.

evidence.quote: In those cases, six months or more is not unreasonable, but bring it up from time to time so no one forgets.

claims.claim: Izin baslangicindan yaklasik iki hafta once yoneticiye ve meslektaslara toplantilarda sozlu hatirlatma yapilmasi tavsiye edilmistir.

evidence.quote: About two weeks before your time off, remind your boss and colleagues verbally in meetings.

claims.claim: Ekip disindaki kisilere veya musterilere izin planinin bir hafta once yazili olarak bildirilmesi gerektigi belirtilmistir.

evidence.quote: If you need to tell someone beyond your team—such as clients or another department—about your planned time off, do so in writing a week before you leave.

claims.claim: Izin baslangicindan iki is gunu once ilgili herkese kisa ve net bir mesaj gonderilmesi gerektigi ifade edilmistir.

evidence.quote: Two business days before your time off begins, send a short, clear message to everyone who needs to know that you will be out.

claims.claim: Izin baslangicinin Pazartesi olmasi durumunda, mesajin Persembe gunu gonderilmesi gerektigi belirtilmistir.

evidence.quote: Why send this message two business days out? Simple: If your first PTO day is Monday, you send this message on Thursday so that anybody who takes off or calls in sick on Friday still sees it in time.

claims.claim: En unutkan yonetici ve is arkadaslari icin iznin ilk gunu saat 08:30da otomatik bir mesaj ayarlanabilecegi ifade edilmistir.

evidence.quote: For those supremely forgetful bosses and coworkers, you might set up an automated message that appears at 8:30 am the first day you're out.
